description: Skill-based eligibility in the Svelte 5 scheduler: each job needs a skill in its requiresField and each technician resource carries a skills array, so a job may only be scheduled onto a qualified technician. Drag one onto someone who lacks the skill and it snaps back with a Not eligible flash, ineligible rows are hatched while you drag, and the same rule gates creating and resizing through the booking-rule pipeline.
keywords: svelte drag only to qualified resource

faq.question: How is eligibility declared?
faq.answer: requiresField names the event field holding the needed skill, and each resource's skills array lists what it can do; a resource is eligible when its array includes the event's skill.

faq.question: What happens on an ineligible drop?
faq.answer: The event animates back to its origin and a Not eligible message flashes; nothing is written to the row.

faq.question: Does it apply to new events?
faq.answer: Yes. Double-clicking a technician's row to add a job pre-fills a skill they have, and the drawer refuses a skill they lack.
